data.narrative:
Near Space Labs is a Series B-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Rema Matevosyan that has raised $40M+. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 5 public-market peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private-sector participants, including Sierra Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Aalyria, and Skyryse.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis uses the $40M total raised as a proxy base and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B advancement, yielding $76M. Peer-median analysis anchors to 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with a median valuation of $1.6B and a range spanning $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to the absence of disclosed revenue data for the target. 

Triangulating the two applicable methods produces a valuation range of $65M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $863M. The wide dispersion—driven substantially by heterogeneity in the peer set—reflects material uncertainty around Near Space Labs' relative position within the Space & Aerospace sector. Stage-progression yields a lower bound consistent with early-stage capital deployment; peer-median implies substantially higher value conditional on comparable competitive positioning and revenue trajectory. Revenue visibility and product-market traction remain critical value drivers not captured in this analysis.
